subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the metadata preservation blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw accept this configure-only custom-provider metadata editor as the product direction, or defer the surface to the broader onboarding metadata tracker?
rationale: The PR adds a new interactive setup surface that rewrites persisted provider model metadata, and repository policy treats setup/config/provider routing behavior as compatibility-sensitive product territory.

options.title: Repair then review configure-only scope
options.body: Fix the concrete metadata preservation bugs first, then let maintainers decide whether this configure-time editor should land as the narrower first step.

options.title: Pause for unified setup design
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers choose one contract across configure, onboarding, and non-interactive setup.

options.title: Close in favor of canonical tracker
options.body: Close this branch if maintainers want all metadata prompt work to be handled by the broader canonical issue and a fresh implementation.

recommendation.title: Repair then review configure-only scope
recommendation.body: Fix the concrete metadata preservation bugs first, then let maintainers decide whether this configure-time editor should land as the narrower first step.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits in the custom-provider setup/config path make this the best available routing candidate for the product-surface decision.
